Summary: Mid-market e-commerce SaaS (merchantflow.ai) — building marketplace search + merchandising for SMB merchants. Want to improve conversion by fixing relevance via a reranking endpoint. Currently prototyping with existing search backend (OpenSearch) + offline ML models; exploring Redwood for runtime rerank and hosted evals.

Key points from discovery/demo:
- Demo 2026-01-28: showed rerank endpoint + score tie-in with product metadata. Product lead: "Hit rate on top-3 needs to go up — currently ~18% -> target 26%". Liked transparent latency / token breakdown in console.
- Primary workload: short query rerank (avg 4 tokens) + offline nightly rescoring for personalization. Expect ~200 QPS peak during promotion windows; p95 latency target 50-150ms for rerank calls.
- POC plan: start on Hosted API for 4-week POC (integration + offline eval), then move to Dedicated if throughput/cost profile favorable. POC success criteria: +8-10% top-3 CTR lift on held-out eval set; offline scoring throughput 10k items/min; p95 latency <= 150ms.
- Security: infosec flagged data residency (EU customers), SOC2 required, need KMS integration for keys. Asked for security FAQ + architecture diagram (uploaded to Drive link).
- Cost sensitivity: mid — willing to commit to Dedicated if we can show clear per-order cost savings vs current host + GC compute. Interested in Optimize recommendations (batching + quantization) to estimate unit economics.
- Offline evals: they have a 50k query eval set but it's noisy; ask SE for help on constructing gold labels and offline scoring harness. Mentioned wanting an API for running offline rerank scoring (batch endpoint) and exports for A/B analysis.

Quotes / snippets:
- "If Redwood can give us deterministic latency at scale and a sensible pricing model, we'll move to Dedicated" — Head of Product (Lena Ortiz).
- "Need to keep PII out of logs; retention and audit controls are non-negotiable" — Sr. InfoSec.

- Sent pricing deck + initial SOW draft 2026-02-05 (Drive).
